text:
I haven't started building. Phase 2 will branch from `main` once you've merged PR #3 (Phase 1 ingestion), which is still open on GitHub.

Before you merge, note that `phase-1-ingestion` has uncommitted AI-log files: `docs/ai-log/raw/cnash03/b1c9df54….jsonl` is modified, and `133e0d28….jsonl` (this session) is new. They'll need committing to PR #3 or to the Phase 2 branch. I can commit and push them to PR #3 now if you want.

Tell me when PR #3 is merged. I'll then pull `main`, create `phase-2-query-api` and build the plan you approved.
